judgement.reason: A stricter outcome is not proven: the Go backend and Nuxt server share one image behind Caddy, and the temporary file storage can plausibly move to S3.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: the start script 015.sh runs 2 long-running servers in the background (/bin/backend, node /app/server/index.mjs) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The start script runs the Go backend and the Nuxt server in the background in one container next to Caddy, so it does not fit the one-web-process model.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./uploads:/uploads (docker-compose.yml app), volume ./uploads:/uploads (docker-compose.yml worker)
reviews.reason: The app and the worker share an uploads volume, and no shown setting moves uploaded files to S3, so the uploads appear to need durable local storage.
